visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and light makeup speaks directly into the camera. She is wearing a beige and brown vest. The background is a vibrant red color, possibly an umbrella. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of her face against a plain light grey wall, highlighting her skin texture and some redness on her cheeks. (3) She is seated inside a brightly lit retail store with Clarins branding visible. She holds a bottle of brown cosmetic serum. (4) A professional aesthetician in a red uniform is seen massaging the woman's face. The woman has a white towel draped over her shoulders. (5) After the massage, the woman looks into a hand mirror, examining her face while gesturing towards her jawline. (6) A split-screen comparison appears showing her face before and after the treatment with text overlays. (7) She returns to a standing position in the store, leaning against a large red branded gift box, smiling and picking out items. (8) The setting changes to a home environment. The woman, now wearing a dark blue hoodie and a black headband, applies the serum to her hands and then presses it onto her face and neck. (9) She demonstrates a specific eye-care routine, pressing her fingers around her eye sockets. (10) She holds up two Clarins serum bottles, one being a gold-toned limited edition with snake graphics, and gestures enthusiastically.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main creator, 1 female aesthetician in store, and 1 female staff member briefly visible in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long black hair, wearing a white vest with brown leather collar over a beige top in the store, and a dark blue hoodie at home.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern Clarins retail counter with white shelves, red accents, and product displays. Later, a simple indoor home setting with a grey wall background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Female voice starts with a neutral, slightly concerned tone discussing skin issues. No BGM. (2) A bright, upbeat electronic pop track with a steady kick drum begins as the voice becomes more energetic. (3) Sound of a subtle mechanical click as a product is handled. (4) In the store, the interplay between the main speaker's excited tone and a professional aesthetician's calm, rhythmic counting ('100 grams... 3 kilograms') creates a structured dialogue. (5) SFX of a soft thud and fabric rustling during the massage. (6) Laughter and high-arousal exclamations as a prize is won. (7) SFX of a plastic seal being broken and a pump sound as the serum is dispensed. (8) Rhythmic skin tapping and slapping sounds as the woman demonstrates facial massage at home. (9) The music swells in volume during transitions, ending with a final enthusiastic call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Experience -> Result -> Demonstration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Clarins skincare products, specifically the Double Serum, by showcasing a professional in-store 'mini SPA' experience followed by a home-care tutorial. It highlights the immediate visible results on the skin and the excitement of a promotional prize draw to encourage viewers to visit the store.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a direct visit to the Clarins store, a professional treatment using their products, and a detailed demonstration and endorsement of the 'Double Serum' including a limited edition reveal.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly produced social media promotional video utilizing fast-paced editing and rhythmic SFX to maintain viewer engagement throughout the product journey.
